                                  text_version, source, consent_evidence)
         VALUES ($1, $2, 'pending', coalesce($3, $4), $5, coalesce($6, now()), $7, 'import', $8)
         ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT subscribers_email_unique DO NOTHING
         RETURNING id
